passages.quote: Draft revised employment tribunal rules of procedures. These incorporate recommendations from the fundamental review of employment tribunal rules conducted by Mr Justice Underhill. See also URN 11/1379 for the review’s terms of reference and 12/952 for a letter from Mr Underhill detailing his recommendations from his review.
